entries.62a1ff2707f882af: A company that supports individual wealthy persons and corporate owners with the succession of assets and businesses, and also offers fractional real estate products.
entries.6ece71cfad1185c9: A category in which, as part of property consulting, real estate is purchased and sold to meet clients' asset management needs. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥29,943 million, consisting of ¥28,389 million from ADVANTAGE CLUB and ¥1,553 million from other real estate transactions. In some cases properties are sold after their value has been raised by sorting out rights relationships, attracting tenants and similar work, and in other cases only brokerage is performed. Business real estate is also supplied to voluntary partnerships formed under the real estate co-ownership system.

entries.9aa73dfd1af5049b: A single segment of a group consisting of the Company, 14 consolidated subsidiaries and 2 affiliated companies. It provides consulting on asset succession, business succession, asset management and more to individual wealthy clients and corporate owners. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥41,785 million, and revenue is classified into real estate transactions and property consulting. The head office is in Minato-ku, Tokyo.
entries.a5dc41fdc0f61aeb: Investors in the real estate co-ownership system
entries.a89b27481778ce36: A category that adds product structuring and other services to consulting on asset succession for individual wealthy clients and business succession for corporate owners. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥11,842 million, consisting of ¥6,496 million from asset succession, ¥3,026 million from business succession and ¥2,319 million from product structuring and other services. In asset succession, it supports pre- and post-inheritance measures, the use of owned real estate and more; in business succession, it supports the decision on a successor, organizational restructuring, M&A and more.
